title: Occasional failed logins from normal users
symptoms: A few 'Login failed for user ops from 49.36.12.7 port 40211' events spread out over an hour, with no burst. Source IPs are normal local ISP addresses, not a high-risk country. Usually one user mistyping a password.
root_cause: Regular users mistyping or forgetting their password. This is normal background noise, not an attack.
impact: None for the system. A single user may be briefly unable to log in.
fix_steps: No action needed unless the same user keeps failing.
If a user is locked out, verify their identity and help them reset the password.
prevention: Offer self-service password reset and SSO so users mistype passwords less often.
